description: A bold angular vessel glyph shaped like a broad open arch with a small shining diamond suspended inside it. Clear symbol of a spirit inside a host, one compact symmetrical emblem, not a shield or flame. One isolated game UI badge, readable at 18 pixels. Refined crisp pixel art matching a warm medieval tactical game UI. Bronze outer shape, warm ivory inner light, three or four flat colors, strong simple silhouette and open negative spaces, no gradient glow. Transparent background, centered complete icon with 6 pixel margin. No lettering, no border panel, no background, no character, no flames, no burning sign.
